messages:
jane_acme_corp: Hey @support — after our Okta migration a few devs and a deploy service account lost the ability to edit projects in the Console. They get a 'You don't have permission' UI state. API calls using our org API key still succeed. Any idea what's up?
alex_support: Sorry about that — can you share an example project ID and a couple affected user emails? Also is this happening to org admins as well? :thinking: 
jane_acme_corp: Project ID: proj-89f. Affected: sam@acme.com, lucy@acme.com, svc-deploy@acme.com. Admins can list projects but edit buttons are disabled. Screenshot sent.
mike_identity: Thanks — quick question: did you rename groups or change SCIM mappings during the Okta migration? Our SCIM sidecar shows a provisioning change around 2024-11-02T14:22Z for acme-corp.
jane_acme_corp: We renamed Okta group 'acme_dev_team' -> 'acme-devs' and updated SCIM mapping from attribute 'memberOf' to 'groups' to avoid a legacy field.
alex_support: That would explain it. When a SCIM-backed group resource changes identifier, role_bindings on the old group don't automatically migrate. Browser console or network trace shows any 403 body?
jane_acme_corp: Console log: 403 on GET /api/v1/projects/proj-89f/rolebindings -> {"error":"permission denied","code":403,"details":"role_binding missing for subject"}
mike_identity: Yep — behavior we see when the group resource was replaced. Two remediation options: 1) re-link the IdP group to the existing group resource (if mapping permits) or 2) run SCIM backfill to recreate role_bindings for the new group resource.
sara_oncall: @mike_identity can you run a scoped backfill for acme-devs? If it looks safe, do a dry-run first then the real run. We want minimal blast radius.
mike_identity: Running dry-run: `scim-backfill --org acme-corp --group acme-devs --dry-run`
Output: 93 subjects would be re-bound; 1 subject flagged (svc-deploy legacy prefix). Scheduling real run in 10m.
jane_acme_corp: Any short-term workaround so people can continue edits in console while you run this?
alex_support: Short-term: org admins can invite the affected users at project-level (Project Settings -> Members) which will create project-specific role_bindings until backfill completes. Alternatively, with an owner-scoped API key you can POST to /api/v1/projects/proj-89f/rolebindings with payload `{"subject":"user:sam@acme.com","role":"editor"}`.
mike_identity: Backfill run complete. CID: cbf-20241102-17. Verified 92/93 subjects re-bound; the service account had a legacy prefix mismatch which I fixed and re-ran for that record.
jane_acme_corp: Confirmed — affected users can edit now. svc-deploy regained deploy rights. Huge thanks. :tada:
alex_support: Glad it's resolved. I'll escalate and add a KB: 'SCIM attribute rename can orphan platform role_bindings — backfill procedure'. Will attach the run command and dry-run example.
idp_bot: Incident logged: INC-2024-4823; Runbook updated: https://internal/runbooks/scim-backfill
jane_acme_corp: Closing thread. Please email the KB link and any post-mortem notes. Thanks everyone!
